title: Stair Generator
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time stair signal generator, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Time (s)} sets the transition times, {Amplitude}, {Repeat stair pattern indefinitely} sets the stair pattern repetition and {Output data type} sets the output data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Time (s)
params.values: Transition times [0.5 1 3 3.5] (default) | row vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Amplitude
params.values: Amplitudes of stair signal values [1 -1 2.5 0] (default) | row vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type double (default) | Inherit: auto | Inherit: Inherit via internal rule | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 |
